overview.description: The ProShares Russell 2000 Autocallable Income ETF (ACRT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 2000 Laddered Autocall index. The fund provides easy access to a complex strategy. The ETF uses swaps to provide exposure to a laddered autocallable strategy ACRT was launched on Aug 13, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
